findings.evidence: openspec/specs/model-routing/spec.md, scenario 'Legacy self-reported launch record reaches the gate', requires directing the supervisor to re-record a claimed execution. In template/scripts/model_routing.py, record_claude_execution now requires a delegated plan and open delegation; begin_claude_delegation refuses any existing execution, and prepare refuses existing implementation content except attributable failed Codex work. Consequently, a legacy Claude record with launched:true and completed task content cannot be converted to the required truthful claimed outcome.
findings.summary: Legacy self-reported Claude launch records can no longer follow the accepted contract’s required re-recording path.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/run_test_groups.py:224–229 imports model_routing unconditionally, and main calls this wrapper at line 310 before executing groups. A project without that module raises ModuleNotFoundError before the managed-state guard can run. This contradicts design.md decision 5: 'Projects without managed state or model_routing are unaffected,' and tasks.md 3.2.
findings.summary: The test entrypoint now requires model_routing even for projects where routing is absent and no managed task exists.
